Create a production sprite sheet for STARLIT-GUILD. Exactly FOUR whole-body seated tea sprites in a strict 2 columns x 2 rows grid, 1536x1024 transparent RGBA. Each cell is 768x512, no borders/numbers/text. Identical scale, head size, face shape, colors, outfit, chair and foot baseline in all four cells, 48px clear padding. Crisp warm pixel-art-like small RPG sprites, dark brown clean outlines and restrained painted pixel shading matching reference 1. Not vector, not smooth oversized anime faces. Preserve the narrow cheeks and head/body proportions of reference 1. Reference 2 is ONLY the seated chair posture/costume detail reference; ignore its other actions and poses. Camera is 3/4 front facing screen RIGHT, gently looking down from above, BOTH eyes readable, NOT pure side profile, NOT straight front. Same angle in all cells. Chair, head, torso, legs and free hand stay in exactly the same places across all frames. ONLY the drinking arm and cup move. Do NOT alter clothing colors between frames. No held object changes hands. Background alpha zero everywhere outside the four character+chair silhouettes.
